description: This source file implements network model query management for WAN interfaces, including creation, response handling, and cleanup of queries related to interface states and modes within a network management system.

classes.name: nm_query_ll_info_t
classes.description: Structure holding query information for network model queries associated with a WAN interface.

classes.name: intf_isup_queries_t
classes.description: Structure representing interface up status queries for IPv4 and IPv6 on a specific interface.

methods.name: void ll_queries_clean(nm_query_ll_info_t ** info)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with a given nm_query_ll_info_t instance.

methods.name: void nm_query_response_phys_up_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon physical interface up/down status change; processes the result.

methods.name: void nm_query_create_phys_up_query(nm_query_ll_info_t * info)
methods.description: Creates a query to monitor the physical interface's operational status.

methods.name: void nm_query_response_ll_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Processes responses from queries about the lower layer of a given interface.

methods.name: void nm_query_create_ll_query(const char * intf_path,nm_query_ll_info_t * info)
methods.description: Creates a query to fetch the lower layer information for a specified interface.

methods.name: void nm_query_response_name_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Handles the response for interface name queries, initiates subsequent queries for lower layer info.

methods.name: bool wan_mode_up(amxd_object_t * wan_mode_obj)
methods.description: Determines whether all interfaces in a WAN mode are operationally up.

methods.name: void nm_query_mode_active_handle_flags(const amxc_var_t * data,amxd_object_t * intf_obj,const char * flag,ipversion_t ip_version)
methods.description: Handles setting or clearing flags based on the active status of the mode interface for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: void nm_query_mode_active_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback for IPv4 mode active status change; updates flags and autosensing accordingly.

methods.name: void nm_query_mode6_active_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback for IPv6 mode active status change; updates flags and autosensing accordingly.

methods.name: int nm_query_create_name_query(amxd_object_t * wan_mode,nm_query_ll_info_t * info,const char * flag)
methods.description: Creates a query to get interface names filtered by mode and state flags.

methods.name: int nm_query_ll_add(amxd_object_t * wan_mode)
methods.description: Main function to add network model queries for a given WAN mode object.

methods.name: void intf_isup_queries_clean(intf_isup_queries_t ** nm_queries)
methods.description: Cleans interface-up-related queries from an interface object.

methods.name: void init_intf_isup_query(amxd_object_t * interface,intf_isup_queries_t * nm_queries,ipversion_t ip_version)
methods.description: Initializes queries to monitor if an interface is up for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: int open_intf_isup_query(amxd_object_t * interface,netmodel_callback_t handler,ipversion_t ip_version)
methods.description: Opens a netmodel query to monitor interface's operational status for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: int nm_query_mode_active(void)
methods.description: Creates and starts queries to monitor whether WAN modes are active and network interfaces are up.

methods.name: void nm_close_sensing_queries(void)
methods.description: Stops all ongoing sensing queries for the current WAN modes and cleans associated resources.
